seo.title: Study Pharmacy in France for Indian Students | Edu-Hawk Worldwide
seo.description: Complete guide to Pharmacy in France for Indian students: Top French universities, admission requirements, tuition fees (€255 – €3,950 / year public), scholarships, and 2-year post-study work visa.

sections.title: 1. How many years of studying Pharmacy in France?

items: The standard **professional pharmacy pathway in France** lasts **at least six years**. Some specialist routes may take longer.

sections.title: 2. Do international students study pharmacy in France?

items: Yes, **international students** may be eligible but entry requirements and application procedures are dependent on nationality, previous qualifications and the program chosen.

sections.title: 3. Do I need to speak French to study pharmacy in France?

items: The majority of **professional pharmacy studies** are taught primarily in French. Students should check the language requirements of the faculty they choose and be ready for professional communication during placements.

sections.title: 4. Tuition fees to study pharmacy in France

items: Costs are affected by **tuition fee status**, university policy and **living expenses**. Check the university for current fees and exemptions.

sections.title: 5. Is it possible to become a pharmacist in India after studying in France?

items: You have to check the **recognition and registration requirements** with the ****Pharmacy Council of India**** and other appropriate authorities. “A French qualification does not mean that you can automatically practice in India.
How could ** **Edu Hawk worldwide Consultancy** ** Help me to study abroad?

Edu Hawk worldwide helps students to explore the suitable universities, understand the admission requirements, organize application documents and plan their study abroad journey. Students are responsible for checking academic, financial, immigration and licensing requirements with the appropriate official authority.

sections.title: 6. **Accept your offer:** Register and follow the instructions of the university.

items: Details available upon request.

sections.title: 7. **Get your visa**: If applicable, follow the **official French student-visa procedure**.

items: Students applying from India should refer to **Campus France India** and the respective university. Some of the routes available for candidates with foreign health qualifications have special procedures and deadlines.

sections.title: 8. Accreditation and Recognition of Pharmacy in France**

items: The state **diploma of the **professional pharmacy pathway**** is the French ***Diplôme d’État de docteur en pharmacie*** . Moreover, graduates need to meet the relevant **professional registration and practice requirements** to be able to practice as a pharmacist in France.
The professional pharmacist diploma and a ****Master of Pharmaceutical Sciences**** or a **pharmacy-related technician qualification** are not the same.
**Indian students:**

If you want to practise as a pharmacist in India, find out the current **qualification-recognition and registration requirements** from the ****Pharmacy Council of India**** and the authorities concerned before enrolling.

sections.title: 9. Salary and Job Prospects after Pharmacy in France**

items: ****Pharmacy graduates in France**** have a number of career options depending on their qualification, specialization, language skills, and professional authorization.
Possible career areas include
* - Community and retail pharmacy Hospital pharmacy.
* - **Manufacturing and Production of Pharmaceuticals**.
* - Quality assurance and quality control.
* - Regulatory and safety affairs of medicines.
* - **Research and development of pharmaceuticals**.
*  **Clinical Research and Medical Biology** in so far as qualified.
* - University teaching and scientific research.
What salary to expect

****Pharmacist salaries in France**** vary according to position, location, experience, employer and the applicable collective agreement. Different pay structures are possible in industry roles, hospital positions, and community pharmacy work.
